questions: When the board is fully in view, are there exactly three pens on it (no missing pen and no empty gap)?
Do all three pens point the same direction, with none flipped or reversed relative to the other two?
Are all three pens the same color as each other, with none differing in color?
Is every pen complete and capped, with none showing a bare/exposed writing tip or looking clearly shorter than the others?
Does the board move smoothly and continuously from left to right, without stopping, freezing, pausing, reversing, or jamming at any point?

question_answers.evidence: At timestamps 00:10-00:15, the board is fully visible and clearly shows exactly three pens arranged in a row.
All three pens are oriented with the cap end pointing downwards relative to the camera frame; none are flipped.
All three pens appear to have identical dark barrels and caps, showing no color variation between them.
Each pen has a cap on the bottom end, and all appear to be full length with no exposed tips or missing parts.
The board translates smoothly and continuously from the left side of the frame to the right side without pausing or jamming.

parsed.reason: The video shows three identical pens on a board moving smoothly across the frame. All pens are capped, oriented in the same direction, and match in color and size.

description: The board pauses mid-travel, then continues.
